answer: Quadratic staking forces each validator to lock collateral C so total voting weight scales as sum C^2 and a Sybil set of size k needs O(k^2) capital to match honest power. The resulting Nash equilibrium ensures rational agents cannot wander past the mesa of honest behavior and the nectar of security rewards compliant participants.
